column1: # The scratch each job needs, in MB: the peak of its lane directory (the cluster of the lane in it) or of its own directory, plus 5%. scripts/ci/jobs.sh reads it to schedule the jobs under the
# budget of the shard (CI_BUDGET_MB); a job not listed counts JOB_MB. A run lists the jobs above their row at its end. Made from the summaries a run retains:
#   scripts/ci.sh --scratch FILE... > new && mv new scripts/scratch.tsv      (FILE: $TMPDIR/sift-ci-summary/*.tsv of the shards of the tier)
